assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Restoring a hardcoded claim-option tuple, or reordering the taxonomy independently of the table, makes the expected literal order differ or raises before the assertion.
Dropping the any-part-conflicts instruction from the contradiction criterion removes the independently expected substring.
Restoring a choice-only veto makes lines 280 and 283 fail for a supports answer carrying contradiction probability 0.32, and raising the threshold past 0.04 makes the negative assertion at 288 fail.
Making the fitted score fall back to zero-filled audit components for an absent report turns both None assertions into numeric scores.
Omitting the house-style audit erases the independently expected flawed finding at 383 and makes the clean and flawed scores at 394 equal; negative-audit-input.log records exactly that red.

findings.text: follow-on: build_docs_audit_report re-implements the convention-violation LintFinding construction that imas_codex/standard_names/review/audits.py:690 run_house_style_checks owns, so a change to the owner's finding text or severity reaches this report only when it is made here by hand.

follow-on: contradiction_reason and raw_claim_answers are produced but read only by tests, because the sole production caller at imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:10924-10938 rebuilds its own reason string from claim_answers, so the named contradictory sentence never reaches a review.
